meaning: The finite rank (OPEN) gives well-founded actual grounding (ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF-FROM-FINITE-RANK), and with excluded middle the proved equivalence borrowingEscapeWFEquivalence turns that into the no-self-contained-borrowing cut: every nonempty set of actual concreta contains a source or the effect of a record whose contributors all lie outside it. It does not use STMT-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF as a premise, so it adds no cycle with ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF-FROM-BORROWING-CUT.

strong_version_needed.STMT-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-FINITE-RANK: The weak version STMT-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF with excluded middle also gives the cut, but STMT-ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF is so far derived only from the cut itself (ACTUAL-GROUNDING-WF-FROM-BORROWING-CUT); using it would close a two-cycle and only restate the recorded equivalence. The strong rank version is used to give a non-circular route (ATTEMPT-ROUND3-COGITO-BASE-REJECTED-EDGES).
